name: SFDC: View Opportunity Details (Known DID)
description: View complete Salesforce opportunity details for a known DID (Deal ID = Opportunity ID). DOES NOT search or look up DIDs — requires a specific DID/opportunity ID as input. Shows fields like Opportunity Name, Stage, Owner, Notes, Close Date, etc. Only use when you already have the DID.

steps.description: Navigate to Salesforce Classic (expects logged-in session)
Wait for search input field to appear
Enter DID parameter into search box
steps.param_description: DID number = the unique Salesforce Opportunity ID

steps.description: Wait for search results to load
Click opportunity record link in search results
Wait for opportunity details page to load

outputs.name: opportunity_details
outputs.label: Opportunity Details
outputs.js: JSON.stringify((function() { var sections = []; document.querySelectorAll('.pbSubsection').forEach(function(sub) { var heading = ''; var h = sub.querySelector('.pbSubheader h3'); if (!h) { var sib = sub.previousElementSibling; while (sib) { if (sib.classList.contains('pbSubheader')) { h = sib.querySelector('h3'); break; } sib = sib.previousElementSibling; } } if (!h) { var sec = sub.closest('.pbSection'); if (sec) h = sec.querySelector('.pbTitle'); } if (h) heading = h.innerText.trim(); var fields = {}; sub.querySelectorAll('table.detailList tr').forEach(function(tr) { var cells = tr.querySelectorAll('td'); for (var i = 0; i + 1 < cells.length; i += 2) { var label = cells[i].innerText.trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '); var valEl = cells[i+1].querySelector('[id$="_ileinner"]'); var value = valEl ? valEl.innerText.trim() : cells[i+1].innerText.trim(); if (label && label !== '\u00a0' && label !== '') fields[label] = value; } }); if (Object.keys(fields).length > 0) sections.push({ section: heading, fields: fields }); }); var teamTable = document.querySelector('table.list'); if (teamTable) { var teamRows = []; teamTable.querySelectorAll('tbody tr.dataRow').forEach(function(tr) { var cells = tr.querySelectorAll('td'); if (cells.length >= 3) { teamRows.push({ member: cells[1].innerText.trim(), role: cells[2].innerText.trim(), be_sub_be: cells[3].innerText.trim(), added_by: cells[4].innerText.trim() }); } }); if (teamRows.length > 0) sections.push({ section: 'Opportunity Team', fields: { 'Opportunity Team Members': JSON.stringify(teamRows) } }); } return sections; })())
outputs.parse_instructions:
The input is a JSON array of page sections from a Salesforce Classic opportunity record. Parse this JSON and extract named fields below. The deal_id/DID is the opportunity being viewed — NOT any DID in opportunity notes. 'Oppty Notes/Next Steps' — extract COMPLETE text without truncation.

CRITICAL FORMATTING INSTRUCTION FOR PRESENTATION:
When rendering the opportunity_details output for the user:
1. Parse the JSON array into readable sections
2. For each section, create a clear header like: \"\n=== SECTION NAME ===\"
3. Under each section header, list each field on its own line as: \"  Field Label: field value\"
4. Skip empty fields (value is empty string or whitespace)
5. For multi-line values (like opportunity notes), preserve line breaks and indent continuation lines
6. Add blank line between sections for visual separation
7. Make it scannable: consistent indentation, clear labels, easy to read
8. Output as clean plain text, NOT as JSON array or [object Object] strings
